question: If x-(1)/(x)=2sqrt2, then what will be the value of x³-(1)/(x³)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k

Here, k = 2√2

Required value = (2√2)³ + 3 × (2√2)

⇒ 16√2 + 6√2 = 22√2

**∴ The correct answer is 22√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x − 1/x = 2√2

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)

Substitute a = x and b = 1/x into the formula:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3 × x × (1/x) × (x − 1/x)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x)

Put the given value of (x − 1/x) = 2√2:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (2√2)³ + 3 × 2√2

⇒ (2√2)³ = 2³ × (√2)³ = 8 × 2√2 = 16√2

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 16√2 + 6√2

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 22√2

**∴ The correct answer is 22√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Sum of Squares Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2. Conversely, if x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Sign Conversion Rules

If x + 1/x = k, then x − 1/x = √(k² − 4). Similarly, if x − 1/x = k, then x + 1/x = √(k² + 4).
